title: Talu tenant API
description: The typed contract for a Talu tenant. Helm/Flux validate a HelmRelease's values against this. Every property carries x-talu-owner: 'consumer' = the integrator/orchestrator writes it per tenant; 'operator' = the site owns it, supplied once from environments/<site>/tenant-defaults.yaml (rendered into the talu-tenant-defaults ConfigMap and merged by the HelmRelease BEFORE spec.values). A consumer that sets an operator-owned field still wins the merge — the split is a contract, not an enforcement — but only the consumer-owned subset is API surface with a compatibility promise. See docs/architecture/adr-api-layer.md §4.

projectUuid.description: talu.io/project-uuid stamped on every object; the manager join key.

slug.description: Tenant namespace name; frozen at creation.

allowedUsers.description: Tenant members (emails) allowed to SSH and hold the scoped RBAC role.

sshUserCaPubKey.description: OPERATOR. Pomerium SSH User CA public key the VMs trust. Injected at reconcile time from ConfigMap pomerium-user-ca via the HelmRelease's valuesFrom/targetPath — never written by a consumer and never committed to a tenant file (an inline value, even "", overrides the injection). Not needed when caTrust.package=true.

caTrust.description: OPERATOR. How SSH User CA trust reaches guests: hand-written file (default) or the rotatable talu-ca-trust package. A site-wide choice tied to the golden-image build, not a per-tenant one.

package.description: Install the talu-ca-trust package (rotatable, auto-updating) instead of hand-writing the trust file.

baked.description: The bootc golden image already carries the talu-ca-trust rpm — write no trust in cloud-init.

aptRepoLine.description: apt source line for the talu-ca-trust repo (required when package=true).

defaults.description: Defaults applied to each VM unless the per-VM entry overrides them. Split ownership: how an image is addressed (source/dataSource/dataSourceNamespace/image) is catalog plumbing the site owns; sizing and the guest principal are the consumer's. The typed API collapses the four operator fields into one consumer-facing catalog name.

source.description: OPERATOR — which image mechanism the site's catalog uses.

vms.description: VMs the tenant owns: name -> spec.

source.description: OPERATOR escape hatch — raw image plumbing. The typed API replaces source/image/dataSource* with one catalog name.

image.description: OPERATOR escape hatch — a raw registry reference. Prefer a site default in tenant-defaults.yaml.

resourceQuota.description: Optional ResourceQuota hard limits (e.g. requests.cpu, requests.memory).

internalIpPool.description: Tier-1 CiliumLoadBalancerIPPool CIDR (empty = off). Consumer-owned, but the CIDR must come from the site's IPAM plan — a consumer cannot invent one.

networkBaseline.description: Layer B opt-in: default-deny egress/ingress on tenant VMs except DNS + own ns + host/health.

securityGroups.description: Cloud-style allow-rules attached to VMs, rendered to CiliumNetworkPolicies.

dashboards.description: Per-tenant Perses dashboard + prom-label-proxy (reachable only via Pomerium); off by default.

logging.description: VM internal logs. Tier 1 (serial console) is always on; Tier 2 (agent) is opt-in per tenant, pushing to a Cilium-pinned per-tenant ingest gateway that stamps this tenant's namespace.

agent.description: Tier 2: run the in-guest agent + render the per-tenant ingest gateway.

paths.description: Tier 2: extra log files the in-guest agent tails.
